review:
The top-tier Panther game in the Mighty Wild series, with a 5,000x max win. Like the other Mighty Wild titles, there are two bonus rounds: Hold the Jackpot and Wild Rampage.

On top of those, you get Cash Infinity, Chance Level and Cash Out, which adds more ways to win in the base game. It was nominated for Best Slot Design at the SiGMA East Europe Awards 2024, and the art is a big part of the appeal. High volatility, 96.16% RTP. It's the Mighty Wild game with the biggest ceiling, so expect it to be the most patient play too.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
